title: TCL 55C715 QLED (2020, Belgium), reports ro.product.model BeyondTV2 / device BeyondTV, board rtd285o (Realtek RT2851),
header:
TCL 55C715 QLED (2020, Belgium), reports ro.product.model BeyondTV2 / device BeyondTV, board rtd285o (Realtek RT2851),
client type TCL-EU-RT2851-S1, software V8-R851T02-LF1V606 (AP06), Android TV 9 (API 28), build PPR1.180610.011,
security patch 2020-09-05, 2 GB RAM. Same firmware as examples/tcl-beyondtv-rt2851/, which was the starting point.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-55c715/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-55c715/debloat.txt
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (Android TV Home 7.x, Play-updated). Live TV app: com.tcl.tv
(launcher config: live_tv_package com.tcl.tv). The launcher's Inputs menu lists HDMI 1-3, AV and Live TV through
TvInputManager; no source_panel fallback needed. Network ADB (port 5555) was open as soon as USB debugging was on.

Tested 2026-10-20 on a real unit: applied in the groups below with a screenshot after each, then rebooted three times.
Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Play Store, Play Movies, Live TV, HDMI through TCL's source menu and the launcher's
Inputs menu, Settings, Chromecast and the Bluetooth remote all kept working. MemAvailable went from 557 MB to
about 780 MB with the same apps; voice_ap dropped from ~27% of one core to ~3% once group 6 was off.
In daily family use since then (streaming apps, live TV through the set-top box on HDMI 1, casting); nothing beyond
the notes below had to be re-enabled.

Quirks on this firmware:
- com.tcl.usercenter comes back enabled at every boot, even with its Play update removed (TCL's boot-time list;
TV Settings also binds to it). Listed anyway: it stays off until the next reboot. Rakuten TV (tv.wuaki.apptv)
does the same, see group 3.
- com.tcl.partnercustomizer also supplies the stock Android TV Home's Inputs icon (and the TCL Channel tile and a
TV Guard shortcut). Disabling it removes the icon; the remote's Source button still works. No effect with a
custom launcher.
- Disabling com.google.android.katniss (group 6) also disables search on the stock home screen, typed search too.
- Settings > Applications opens TCL "TV Guard" (com.tcl.tvweishi), and still does while it is disabled.
- Re-enable com.tcl.tvweishi and com.tcl.appmarket2 (group 7) while installing the launcher, as on the RT2851 list.

Already disabled at the factory, left alone: the 14 uk.co.freeview.* apps, com.tcl.bootadservice,
com.tcl.common.terminalmanagerplus, com.tcl.smartalexa, com.tcl.notereminder, com.tcl.gallery, Stan, ZEE5, Eros Now,
LINE TV, Play Music, Play Games.

DO NOT DISABLE (load-bearing on this firmware, as on tcl-beyondtv-rt2851):
com.tcl.tv com.tcl.tvinput com.tcl.tvpassthrough com.tcl.sourcemananger com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice
com.tcl.framework.custom com.tcl.tcl_bt_rcu_service com.tcl.autopair com.google.android.tv.remote.service
com.tcl.inputmethod.international com.tcl.settings com.tcl.initsetup com.tcl.factory.view com.tcl.showmode
com.tcl.xian.StartandroidService com.tcl.appstatecontroller com.realtek.netflix.setting com.android.WifiCountryService
Also kept: com.tcl.videoplayer (serves Live TV info dialogs), com.tcl.audioplayer ("listen with the screen off"),
com.tcl.imageplayer, com.tcl.UpdatePeripheral (boot-time peripheral updater, purpose unclear), com.tcl.rc.ota.

apps.note: TCL Channel tile, promo rows; also the stock home's Inputs icon (see above)
unused, Google WebView is the active provider

optional.note: Rakuten TV: re-enabled at every boot like usercenter; removed for the user instead
